cases.measure: A regional grant covering 60% of deep insulation retrofit costs for dwellings with damp or draught problems. Homeowners apply with a certified survey; works are completed within 18 to 24 months.
cases.expert_notes: Delay, co-payment, recognition, procedural access, and cumulative burden are expected probes.

cases.measure: An automatic scrappage payment for registered low-income car owners replacing old diesel vehicles with used electric vehicles.
cases.expert_notes: Parameter-level incentive, rebound risk, and residual affordability should be surfaced.

cases.measure: A local housing association advice service helps tenants apply for heating upgrades and prioritises homes with mould complaints.
cases.expert_notes: Intermediary discretion, procedural access, and adviser capacity should be checked.

cases.measure: A winter tariff credit is paid automatically to households using prepayment meters when monthly electricity prices exceed a fixed threshold.
cases.expert_notes: Automatic price relief is parameter-level and may miss excluded vulnerable groups or longer-term exposure.

cases.measure: A regional regulation requires landlords to bring rental homes below an energy performance threshold by 2030, with inspections carried out by municipal officers.
cases.expert_notes: Long implementation horizon, inspection capacity, evidence gaps, recognition, and long-lived burden are material.

cases.measure: A municipal cooperative offers zero-interest loans for apartment blocks to install shared rooftop solar, with repayment through building service charges.
cases.expert_notes: Housing-energy coupling, cooperative governance, repayment burden, application access, and long-term duties should appear.

cases.measure: A demand-responsive minibus service connects rural villages to health and employment centres, but bookings must be made through a smartphone app at least 24 hours ahead.
cases.expert_notes: Booking delay, fleet capacity, digital exclusion, and procedural access are the expected lenses.

cases.measure: A low-emission zone restricts older vans in the city centre while small businesses may apply for a one-year exemption if replacement would threaten viability.
cases.expert_notes: Behavioural response, eligibility judgement, application burden, and interaction with business-support measures are relevant.

cases.measure: Students in disadvantaged neighbourhoods receive a voucher for 40% of the purchase price of an e-bike from approved retailers.
cases.expert_notes: Co-payment, retailer channel, rebound or price response, and omitted non-student groups need scrutiny.

cases.measure: A regional training programme funds new heat-pump installer apprenticeships and gives firms bonuses for placements in remote districts.
cases.expert_notes: Cross-sector labour coupling, delayed benefit, delivery capacity, and evidence assumptions should be raised.

cases.measure: Tenants reporting severe mould can request a fast-track municipal inspection and a binding repair order against the landlord within 60 days.
cases.expert_notes: Inspection capacity, discretion, unrecognised tenant subgroups, and access to complaint routes matter.

cases.measure: Private renters can nominate their home for publicly funded insulation if the landlord signs a consent form and agrees to a three-year rent freeze.
cases.expert_notes: Landlord consent, discretion, tenant recognition, procedural barriers, and interaction with rent policy are expected.

cases.measure: Buildings in selected urban zones must connect to district heating within five years, with connection fees waived for households receiving income support.
cases.expert_notes: Urban infrastructure coupling, delay, network capacity, eligibility criteria, and residual costs should fire.

cases.measure: Households with smart meters are moved by default to a time-of-use tariff unless they opt out through an online supplier portal.
cases.expert_notes: Demand response assumptions, opt-out criteria, digital recognition, and procedural access are central.

cases.measure: A monthly bus fare cap limits commuting costs for registered jobseekers travelling to interviews or training appointments.
cases.expert_notes: Parameter-level relief, eligibility rules, excluded users, and registration burden should be checked.

cases.measure: Micro-businesses can apply for a grant covering half the cost of a cargo bike to replace short delivery trips in dense urban areas.
cases.expert_notes: Financial incentive depth, market response, co-payment, and application procedures are expected.

cases.measure: Public housing estates are retrofitted block by block over six years, starting with buildings that have the highest measured heat loss.
cases.expert_notes: Phasing delay, stock capacity, prioritisation criteria, long-term exposure, and repeated burdens are relevant.

cases.measure: Municipal libraries and community halls are converted into cooling centres during heatwaves, with opening hours published online each morning.
cases.expert_notes: Cross-sector venue dependency, staffing capacity, recognition gaps, and online access should be surfaced.

cases.measure: Residents can join a community battery scheme by paying a membership deposit, receiving lower evening electricity prices once the battery is installed.
cases.expert_notes: Installation delay, price response, deposit burden, membership access, and long-term obligations are expected.

cases.measure: Low-income households may apply for a voucher replacing inefficient refrigerators after submitting proof of income and an energy audit.
cases.expert_notes: Parameter intervention, audit capacity, eligibility judgement, recognition, and documentation burden should fire.

cases.measure: Night bus routes are added for hospital and logistics shift workers, with service reviewed after six months based on passenger counts.
cases.expert_notes: Feedback loops, service capacity, success criteria, and omitted night travellers should be checked.

cases.measure: Streets around primary schools are closed to private cars during arrival and departure times, with permits for residents and carers.
cases.expert_notes: Travel behaviour response, permit criteria, excluded carers, and interaction with other access policies are relevant.

cases.measure: Doorstep energy advisers visit apartment blocks with high arrears and help households switch supplier, claim benefits, and request minor repairs.
cases.expert_notes: Cross-sector advice, adviser discretion, recognition, procedural access, and cumulative demands are expected.

cases.measure: A social tariff reduces district heating bills for pensioners and disability benefit recipients after municipal welfare offices verify eligibility.
cases.expert_notes: Tariff depth, eligibility boundary, welfare-office discretion, recognition, and verification access should be surfaced.

cases.measure: Owners of long-vacant homes pay a rising tax unless they renovate the property for affordable rental within three years.
cases.expert_notes: Delayed rental benefit, owner response, eligibility criteria, and long-term housing burden are material.

cases.measure: Charging points are installed in social housing car parks for shared electric vehicles operated by a local mobility cooperative.
cases.expert_notes: Housing-transport coupling, charging and fleet capacity, cooperative discretion, recognition, and access rules should appear.
